description: Built-in rule library for windows-c-cleanup. Paths use %ENV% placeholders and hardcode no user names, so they can be reused across machines. grade: safe = safe to delete, caution = delete with care, migrate = recommend relocating, protected = protection list (hard constraint), longterm = long-term protection
notes: Matching: a candidate path is a hit when it equals the rule path or lies beneath the rule directory; rules containing * are treated as single-segment wildcards.
Precedence: the longest (most specific) matching path wins; at equal length, protected wins.
Rules with overridable:false are hard constraints and cannot be overridden by user-defined rules (unless allowProtectedOverride is explicitly enabled).
Any directory that matches no rule at all is treated as protected (when in doubt, do not delete).

reasons.temp-user: User temporary files directory; applications keep generating files here while running and it is rebuilt automatically after deletion; in-use files are skipped
reasons.temp-windows: System temporary directory, mostly leftovers from installers and system components; some files require administrator rights
reasons.win-update-download: Windows Update download cache; safe to delete once updates have finished installing, requires administrator rights
reasons.recycle-bin: Recycle Bin; deleting means permanently emptying it, so confirm with the user before running
reasons.crash-dumps: Application crash dump files, useful only for post-mortem troubleshooting
reasons.thumbcache: File Explorer thumbnail cache; rebuilt automatically; if files are in use, close Explorer windows first
reasons.iconcache: File Explorer icon cache; rebuilt automatically
reasons.d3d-shader-cache: DirectX shader cache; games and graphics applications rebuild it automatically
reasons.nvidia-glcache: NVIDIA OpenGL shader cache; rebuilt automatically
reasons.inetcache: WinINet network cache; browsers and system components rebuild it automatically
reasons.npm-cache-local: npm package cache, often several GB; recommended to relocate to another drive and free the space on C:
reasons.npm-cache-roaming: Another common location for the npm package cache; safe to delete
reasons.pip-cache: pip download cache; safe to delete, but relocating it to another drive for long-term use is preferable
reasons.uv-cache-local: uv (Python package manager) cache; can be cleaned with uv cache clean or relocated
reasons.uv-cache-roaming: Another uv cache directory; safe to delete
reasons.go-build-cache: Go build cache; can be cleaned with go clean -cache and is rebuilt automatically
reasons.node-gyp-cache: node-gyp compiled header cache; downloaded again automatically
reasons.generic-updaters: Installer packages downloaded by various application updaters (Electron updaters and the like); applications re-download them on demand
reasons.user-dot-cache: General-purpose user-level cache directory (shared by toolchains); rebuilt on demand after deletion
reasons.yarn-cache: Yarn package cache; safe to delete
reasons.vscode-cached-vsix: VS Code extension package cache; downloaded again when extensions update
reasons.vscode-cached-data: VS Code compiled output cache; rebuilt automatically
reasons.vscode-cache: VS Code cache directory; rebuilt automatically
reasons.vscode-code-cache: VS Code core script cache; rebuilt automatically
reasons.wps-download: Installer and upgrade packages downloaded by WPS; measured at roughly 2 GB in practice
reasons.wps-addons: WPS feature add-on components (about 1.8 GB); deleting them makes some features re-download on first use, so confirm with the user before deleting
reasons.wxwork-upgrade: WeCom (WeChat Work) upgrade package cache; measured at roughly 2 GB in practice
reasons.lark-shadercache: Feishu (Lark) GPU shader cache; rebuilt automatically
reasons.lark-iron-cache: Feishu (Lark) embedded browser cache; cleaning it frees space but discards the local web cache (login state is not stored in this directory)
reasons.qoder-index: Qoder code index (about 1.6 GB); rebuilt when you next open a project, and search is slower while it rebuilds
reasons.chrome-cache: Chrome web cache; rebuilt automatically; exiting Chrome first is recommended
reasons.chrome-code-cache: Chrome script compilation cache; rebuilt automatically
reasons.chrome-profile-caches: Web cache of other Chrome profiles
reasons.chrome-ondevice-model: Chrome on-device AI model (measured at about 4 GB); Chrome may re-download it on demand after deletion, and the feature can be turned off in settings
reasons.chrome-ondevice-classifier: Chrome on-device AI classifier model; can be deleted but may be downloaded again
reasons.jetbrains-caches-local: JetBrains IDE index cache (can reach several GB); the index is rebuilt the first time you open a project after deletion. Skip it if the user asks to keep IDE caches
reasons.jetbrains-index-local: JetBrains index data; rebuilt after deletion
reasons.hermes-cache: React Native Hermes bytecode cache; recompiled after deletion; can be relocated to another drive
reasons.lingma-data: Tongyi Lingma AI assistant local data (about 1.9 GB); contains models and indexes that must be downloaded again after deletion
reasons.maven-repo: Maven local repository, growing with your projects; can be relocated to another drive or deleted (a rebuild downloads everything again)
reasons.gradle-caches: Gradle dependency cache; can be relocated to another drive
reasons.nuget-packages: NuGet package cache; can be relocated to another drive
reasons.cargo-registry: Rust Cargo dependency cache; can be relocated
reasons.vscode-extensions: VS Code extension install directory (measured at about 1.9 GB); can be relocated to another drive with a junction, and extensions keep working
reasons.nvm-versions: Node versions installed by nvm-windows (about 100-300 MB each); old versions can be deleted, but relocating requires updating PATH and NVM_HOME accordingly
reasons.packages-store: UWP/Store application data directory; only its LocalCache/TempState subdirectories can be cleaned, and deleting the whole thing loses application data
reasons.connected-devices: Cross-device continuity data cache; deleting it temporarily affects features such as "continue on other devices"
reasons.webcache: System web cache (a few hundred MB); it cannot be deleted while in use, so stop the related services first
reasons.winsxs: Component store (measured at about 11 GB); can only be cleaned with DISM run as administrator, never deleted directly
reasons.windows-logs: Windows log directory; some files are in use by the system and are skipped
reasons.defender-scan-history: Windows Defender scan history, requires administrator rights
reasons.programdata-packages: Visual Studio / installer package cache; deleting it forces a re-download when repairing or uninstalling those programs
reasons.user-downloads: Downloads directory; never deleted automatically (whether to clean it is the user's own decision)
reasons.user-secrets: SSH keys and configuration; these are credentials
reasons.dsh-home: DeepSeek Harness configuration and session data; deleting it loses all sessions and credentials
reasons.dsh-agents-home: Root directory of local Agent/Skill configuration
reasons.npmrc-file: npm configuration file (holds registry and cache path settings)
reasons.lark-user-data: Feishu (Lark) account and local data (measured at about 4.6 GB); deleting it forces a re-login and a full data re-sync
reasons.lark-sdk-storage: Feishu (Lark) SDK local storage, holding login state and business data
reasons.wxwork-data: WeCom (WeChat Work) chat history and file data (its upgrade/Log subdirectories are covered by separate safe rules)
reasons.wechat-data: WeChat chat history and files (including images, videos and documents)
reasons.xwechat-data: Chat file directory of the new WeChat version
reasons.wps-user-data: WPS user configuration and document data (its download/addons subdirectories are covered by separate rules)
reasons.vscode-user-config: VS Code user configuration, keybindings and snippets
reasons.chrome-user-profile: Chrome user profile (bookmarks, passwords, login state; its cache subdirectories are covered by separate safe rules)
reasons.jetbrains-config: JetBrains IDE configuration, plugins and project history (its cache subdirectories under Local are covered by separate rules)
reasons.docker-data: Docker Desktop data and the WSL backend; can only be managed through Docker's own tools
reasons.wsl-vhdx: WSL distribution virtual disks; deleting them destroys the entire Linux environment, so they can only be exported/relocated with WSL tools
reasons.any-vhdx: Virtual disk file, possibly WSL/Docker/virtual machine data
reasons.hiberfil: Hibernation file; space can only be reclaimed by turning hibernation off with powercfg
reasons.program-files: Installed programs directory; automatic cleaning is forbidden
reasons.program-files-x86: Installed 32-bit programs directory; automatic cleaning is forbidden
reasons.windows-dir: Windows system directory; automatic cleaning is forbidden

relocate-npm-cache.title: Relocate the npm cache to another drive
relocate-npm-cache.detect: %LOCALAPPDATA%\npm-cache exists and is larger than 500 MB
relocate-npm-cache.action: npm config set cache "<other drive>:\npm-cache" (and copy the existing cache contents over)
relocate-npm-cache.benefit: Keeps the package cache from continuously occupying C:

relocate-pip-cache.title: Redirect the pip / uv cache
relocate-pip-cache.action: Set the user environment variables PIP_CACHE_DIR and UV_CACHE_DIR to point at another drive
relocate-pip-cache.benefit: Python toolchain caches no longer write to C:

enable-storage-sense.title: Turn on Windows Storage Sense
enable-storage-sense.action: Registry settings: 01=1 (enable), 04=1 (delete temporary files), 08=1 (daily), 32=30 (Recycle Bin after 30 days), 64=0 (do not clean Downloads automatically)
enable-storage-sense.benefit: Windows automatically cleans temporary files and the Recycle Bin on a schedule

check-wsl-docker-location.title: Check the location of WSL / Docker virtual disks
check-wsl-docker-location.action: Use WSL export/import or Docker Desktop settings to move the data disks to another drive
check-wsl-docker-location.benefit: Virtual disks often grow to tens of GB and are the most easily overlooked consumer of C: space

move-large-projects.title: Keep large development data on another drive
move-large-projects.detect: User projects/node_modules are located on C:
move-large-projects.action: Move project directories and JetBrains/IDE projects to another drive; when needed, use junctions to relocate extension and cache directories
move-large-projects.benefit: Prevents C: from being swallowed by development data at the source

schedule-disk-cleanup.title: Run system Disk Cleanup regularly
schedule-disk-cleanup.action: Run cleanmgr /sagerun:NN as administrator on a schedule (including update cleanup and Delivery Optimization files)

configHints.pip-cache: set the user environment variable PIP_CACHE_DIR=<new path>
configHints.uv-cache-local: set the user environment variable UV_CACHE_DIR=<new path>
configHints.gradle-caches: set the environment variable GRADLE_USER_HOME=<new path>
configHints.nuget-packages: set the environment variable NUGET_PACKAGES=<new path>
configHints.cargo-registry: set the environment variable CARGO_HOME=<new path>
